working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'T4.T5' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature T4/T5 cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: Authors left all T4/T5 subtypes (T4a-d, T5a-d) unsplit in the early data. FBbt has immature T4 (FBbt:00052257) and immature T5 (FBbt:00052258) but no combined T4/T5 term; the common parent immature T neuron is the nearest grouping term (it also covers T2/T3, hence broad).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T4 neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only the T4 half of the grouped cluster.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T5 neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only the T5 half of the grouped cluster.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature T4a only; cells are immature and the cluster groups all T4/T5 subtypes.

recommendation: Broad match to immature T neuron (common parent of immature T4 and T5).
